description: Header file defining structures, function prototypes, and constants for managing AP Multicast Listener Daemon (APMLD) in a wireless LAN context.

methods.name: wld_apMld_areAllBssEnabled
methods.description: Checks if all BSSs in a given MLD unit are enabled.

methods.name: wld_apMld_fetchAffiliatedStaInfo
methods.description: Fetches information about an affiliated station for a given MLD unit and MAC address.

methods.name: wld_apMld_getActiveApAffiliatedStaInfo
methods.description: Retrieves active affiliated station info for a specific access point and MAC address.

methods.name: wld_apMld_notifyChange
methods.description: Notifies about changes in MLD state or configuration.

methods.name: wld_apMld_getOrCreateDmObject
methods.description: Gets or creates a DM object for a specified MLD unit and type.

methods.name: wld_apMld_createAffiliatedAPObject
methods.description: Creates an affiliated access point object linked to a specific MLD link.

methods.name: wld_apMld_deleteAffiliatedAPObjects
methods.description: Deletes affiliated AP objects starting from a specified link.

methods.name: wld_apMld_clearMld
methods.description: Clears or resets the specified MLD.

methods.name: wld_apMld_getMldfromObj
methods.description: Retrieves the MLD structure from a given object.

methods.name: wld_apMld_updateDM
methods.description: Updates the DM (Distribution Map) for a given SSID.

methods.name: wld_apMld_hasSharedConnectionConf
methods.description: Checks if an access point has shared connection configuration with other links.
